Gap: No public labelled theft dataset from Bangladesh
Why it matters for Bangladesh: Models cannot be trained or compared locally
Concrete direction: Utility-academic data trust; anonymised monthly bills with inspection outcomes

Gap: Few controlled field evaluations of detectors in non-AMI grids
Why it matters for Bangladesh: Offline accuracy does not show inspection yield; field designs lack controls
Concrete direction: Randomised or stepped-wedge inspection pilots that report confirmed share and recovered energy
Validate on inspection-confirmed cases; publish negative results

Gap: Label bias from inspection targeting and collusion
Why it matters for Bangladesh: Models learn where inspectors went; bribed inspectors mislabel thieves

Gap: Prepaid vend data rarely used for detection
Why it matters for Bangladesh: Millions of prepaid meters produce recharge streams
Concrete direction: Detection on recharge frequency and amount; tamper alarms

Why it matters for Bangladesh: Theft and demand estimates vary widely
Concrete direction: Metered sampling of garages; charger efficiency standards

Gap: E3W charging outside the regulatory frame
Why it matters for Bangladesh: The 2022 charging guideline covers only BRTA-authorised vehicles
Concrete direction: Legal definition, licensed hubs, charging tariff, smart chargers

Gap: No Bangladeshi evidence on theft drivers
Concrete direction: District panel and household surveys on price, supply quality, trust

Gap: Loss reporting mixes technical and non-technical loss
Concrete direction: Transformer metering and energy audits per feeder

Gap: Treatment of system loss in tariffs not publicly documented
Why it matters for Bangladesh: Decides whether utilities or consumers pay for theft
Concrete direction: Publish loss targets and their use in revenue requirements
